paths.description: Requested entry URL and final general portal landing page; represents navigation, dashboard, and service discovery.
About Us content archetype; represents long-form departmental information.
Contact page archetype; checked contact information and any user-entry fields.
FAQ/listing archetype; represents help and disclosure navigation.
FPS Wise List of Beneficiaries; representative read-only core public-distribution task and dense report table.
Unknown route; tests HTTP failure state and recovery.

findings.summary: The site ignores the user’s dark colour-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: The dark-mode computed-style probe reported color-scheme: normal and retained the light rgb(255, 250, 224) body surface under prefers-color-scheme: dark.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide preference-driven light/dark surface and text tokens.

findings.summary: High-contrast users are not given a robust, preference-aware presentation.
findings.evidence: The CSS feature probe found zero prefers-contrast or forced-colors rules, while axe found 28 definite colour-contrast failures and 43 additional nodes needing review.
findings.suggestedFix: Add forced-colors/prefers-contrast adaptations and correct all text and control contrast failures.

findings.summary: Navigation and state changes use abrupt legacy swaps rather than View Transitions.
findings.evidence: The fetched CSS feature probe found zero view-transition usage across the page stylesheets.
findings.suggestedFix: Use same-document and cross-document View Transitions for major state and page changes, with reduced-motion fallbacks.

findings.summary: The very long home page has no scroll-state-aware navigation or progress affordance.
findings.evidence: The mobile layout measured a 12,335px document; CSS inspection found no modern scroll-state/timeline feature and the captured header remains static.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a compact sticky, scroll-state-aware header or progress affordance that does not obscure content.

findings.summary: Menus and overlays rely on legacy custom positioning without anchor-position fallbacks.
findings.evidence: DOM inspection found a Bootstrap custom modal, no popover/dialog primitives, and CSS inspection found zero anchor positioning declarations.
findings.suggestedFix: Use Popover plus CSS anchor positioning and position-try fallbacks for transient menus.

findings.summary: A custom Bootstrap modal is used instead of native dismissible overlay primitives.
findings.evidence: The platform probe found one .modal but zero dialog, popover, or details elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Use dialog for modal flows and popover/details for transient or disclosure UI, preserving focus and light-dismiss behavior.

findings.summary: The mobile first viewport is dominated by utility chrome before core services appear.
findings.evidence: The 360px screenshot shows date/social buttons, accessibility controls, a style selector, a large crest/title block, language control, and navigation before service content.
findings.suggestedFix: Collapse secondary utility controls into a compact accessible menu and move primary citizen services into the first viewport.

findings.summary: Components use only legacy viewport layout, with no container-level adaptation.
findings.evidence: The fetched CSS feature probe found zero @container rules and 651 physical-direction declarations versus zero logical declarations.
findings.suggestedFix: Introduce container queries for reusable service cards and navigation components while retaining safe fallbacks.

findings.summary: Many interactive targets are too small for reliable touch input.
findings.evidence: The active-control probe found 39 of 52 visible interactive elements below 44px in at least one dimension, including 11–20px social links and a 21px-high select.
findings.suggestedFix: Give controls a minimum 44×44px activation area, preserve visible focus, and avoid hover-only cues.

findings.summary: The requested public-distribution URL does not lead directly to its expected core task.
findings.evidence: HAR evidence records four redirects, including an HTTPS-to-HTTP hop, before landing on the general Food & Supplies home page; the first mobile viewport contains no ration-card action.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep the requested service URL stable or redirect directly to the relevant service landing page, with the primary ration-card action above the fold.

findings.summary: Failure states provide no useful recovery path.
findings.evidence: A deliberately unknown route renders a bare “Server Error / 404 - File or directory not found” page with no site navigation, search, home link, or retry guidance.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide a branded 404/error template with a plain-language explanation and links back to Home, services, contact, and search.

findings.summary: The landing experience is extremely slow and visually unstable.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured FCP 11.9s, LCP 15.3s, Speed Index 16.0s, and CLS 0.287; the independent trace measured LCP 8.45s.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the LCP asset, reserve layout space, compress responses, and remove unnecessary critical resources; verify LCP ≤2.5s and CLS ≤0.1.

findings.summary: Late content shifts the page substantially during loading.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured CLS 0.287, and the image audit found all 71 images lacked width and height attributes.
findings.suggestedFix: Set intrinsic width/height or aspect-ratio on every image and reserve space for dynamic banners and fonts.

findings.summary: Critical resource delivery is uncompressed, uncached, and render-blocking.
findings.evidence: HAR captured 101 requests and 2.10MB transferred, ten parser-inserted high-priority stylesheets, multiple uncompressed CSS/JS/document responses, and missing cache headers on major assets.
findings.suggestedFix: Compress text, consolidate critical CSS/font requests, self-host or reduce fonts, add long-lived immutable caching to versioned assets, and prioritize the actual LCP resource.

findings.summary: Large amounts of legacy CSS and JavaScript are shipped unused.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 289KiB unused CSS and 86KiB unused JavaScript, including 94% unused bootstrap.css and 76% unused bootstrap.min.js.
findings.suggestedFix: Build a route-specific CSS/JS bundle, remove unused Bootstrap/Font Awesome/Swiper code, and defer optional widgets.

findings.summary: Core controls and images lack accessible names and valid role relationships.
findings.evidence: axe found critical image-alt, select-name, aria-required-children and aria-required-parent violations; the image audit counted 24 missing alt attributes.
findings.suggestedFix: Add meaningful alt text or decorative empty alt, label the style select, name icon links, and repair tab/list ARIA structure using native semantics.

findings.summary: Important dashboard text and tabs fail WCAG AA contrast.
findings.evidence: axe found 28 confirmed contrast failures; Lighthouse examples include 3.5:1 and 3.85:1 text combinations where 4.5:1 is required.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace failing color tokens and test every themed state to WCAG AA, including focus, hover, and high-contrast modes.

findings.summary: The document lacks essential language, main-landmark, and top-level heading structure.
findings.evidence: axe reported html-has-lang, landmark-one-main, page-has-heading-one, region and listitem violations; the probe found no main and no h1.
findings.suggestedFix: Set the correct lang, add one descriptive h1, use main/nav/header/footer landmarks, and repair list semantics while preserving the visible focus outline.

findings.summary: Although the page reflows at 360px, target sizing remains inaccessible.
findings.evidence: Layout showed no horizontal overflow, but 39 of 52 visible controls were below 44px in one dimension.
findings.suggestedFix: Preserve the current narrow reflow and enlarge all interactive targets and spacing without disabling zoom.

findings.summary: The production home page throws multiple JavaScript exceptions.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse logged “DataTable is not a function”, an undefined .top access, a null innerHTML assignment, and a favicon 404.
findings.suggestedFix: Load required dependencies before consumers, guard optional elements, remove stale initializers, and add production error monitoring.

findings.summary: Document and image asset hygiene is poor.
findings.evidence: The image audit found 71/71 images without intrinsic dimensions, 55 oversized images, 71 legacy-format images, and 66 below-fold images not lazy-loaded; axe also found a deprecated marquee.
findings.suggestedFix: Add intrinsic dimensions, responsive sources and lazy loading, convert suitable assets to AVIF/WebP, and replace marquee with semantic content and optional CSS motion.

findings.summary: Legacy dependencies and broken runtime assumptions reduce platform reliability.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse runtime evidence shows three uncaught TypeErrors, while HAR shows jQuery, Bootstrap, two Owl Carousel sources, and a missing favicon.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove duplicate/stale libraries, fix dependency ordering, test BFCache/runtime behavior, and eliminate all production console errors.

findings.summary: Canonical crawling and indexing support is incomplete.
findings.evidence: The final page has no canonical link; both /robots.txt and /sitemap.xml returned 404, and the original hostname performs four redirects including an intermediate HTTP URL.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish robots.txt and sitemap.xml, add self-referencing canonicals, and replace the redirect chain with one permanent HTTPS redirect.

findings.summary: Share and structured metadata are mostly empty.
findings.evidence: The probe found zero JSON-LD blocks and only one populated Open Graph field despite multiple empty og tags in the DOM.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate Organization/WebSite JSON-LD and complete Open Graph/Twitter metadata for representative public pages.

findings.summary: Baseline transport and browser security headers are absent.
findings.evidence: The headers primitive found no CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options/frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy; the redirect chain also includes an HTTP hop.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve a single HTTPS redirect and deploy a restrictive CSP, HSTS, nosniff, frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy.

findings.summary: The site does not configure browser-enforced defensive policies.
findings.evidence: Header inspection found no clickjacking protection, HSTS, CSP/Trusted Types foundation, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy.
findings.suggestedFix: Define frame-ancestors, HSTS, a nonce/hash CSP with Trusted Types where applicable, strict referrer handling, and a least-privilege Permissions-Policy.

findings.summary: Core runtime behavior is fragile under ordinary loading.
findings.evidence: Three uncaught TypeErrors occur on the home page, including missing plugin and null/undefined element assumptions.
findings.suggestedFix: Guard optional DOM access, sequence dependencies explicitly, and test navigation/menu behavior with failed or delayed dependencies.

findings.summary: HTTP failure handling falls back to a dead-end server page.
findings.evidence: The 404 test produced a generic server error without site context or recovery controls.
findings.suggestedFix: Route 404/500/network failures through resilient templates with retry and safe navigation options.

findings.summary: The bilingual site does not declare document language and is not writing-mode resilient.
findings.evidence: The DOM has an empty html lang, axe flags html-has-lang, and CSS inspection found 651 physical-direction declarations versus zero logical-property declarations.
findings.suggestedFix: Set lang per language route, set dir where needed, and migrate layout spacing/positioning to logical properties.

findings.summary: Visible date formatting is fixed to English despite a Bengali language option.
findings.evidence: The mobile screenshot renders “Sunday, July 19, 2026” while the page offers Language/ভাষা, and no document language is declared.
findings.suggestedFix: Format dates and numbers with Intl using the selected locale and ensure Bengali routes emit bn language metadata.

findings.summary: Image delivery is substantially oversized and unoptimized.
findings.evidence: The image audit found 55 oversized images, 71 legacy-format images, 66 below-fold images without lazy loading, and no modern-format images; HAR transferred 1.27MB of images.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate responsive AVIF/WebP sources, size assets to rendered dimensions, lazy-load below-fold imagery, and retain fallbacks only where needed.

findings.summary: The page performs avoidable network and parsing work.
findings.evidence: HAR captured 101 requests, three separate Google Fonts stylesheets, two Owl Carousel sources, and uncached/uncompressed legacy bundles; Lighthouse found large unused code.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove duplicate libraries/font requests, cache static assets, and load optional sections only when needed.

findings.summary: Third-party and decorative resource cost is disproportionate to this public-service page.
findings.evidence: HAR attributed 93 requests and 2.096MB to origins other than the requested hostname, including external font and carousel CDNs; the total transfer was 2.10MB.
findings.suggestedFix: Consolidate the canonical origin, self-host essential fonts/code, remove unused carousels, and enforce a route-level transfer budget.
